debate.key_bear_argument: Absence of near-term momentum confirmation (no bullish crossovers, bearish MACD, price below EMA-9/21), severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), high earnings risk within 14 days, and zero fundamental conviction make this a low-probability entry with asymmetric downside risk.
